text:
The evidence is insufficient to say for the whole period, and it can't prove there was no fire in any case.

For the evaluated period (2026-09-25 to 2026-10-25), NASA FIRMS found no thermal detections intersecting the asset (ASSET-F02) on the days it covered, 2026-09-25 to 2026-10-24. This holds for all four sensors: MODIS and the three VIIRS satellites.

The final day, 2026-10-24 to 2026-10-25, is not covered by any sensor. The near-real-time files had not yet been updated for that day, so the period has a gap.

Even for the covered days, "no detections" is not proof of "no fire". Small, short-lived, cool, or cloud-obscured fires can go undetected. The data also says nothing about burned area or about anything outside this period.

In short, no satellite-detected fire was found on the covered days, but the last day is unchecked and undetected fires can't be ruled out.
